topic: Choose a team messaging tool for a small game studio

scenario.topic: Choose a team messaging tool for a small game studio
scenario.opening_question: What matters most to us when picking a messaging tool: cost, integrations, or ease of use?

options.name: Slack Standard Plan
options.upside: Robust integrations with game development tools and bots
options.tradeoff: Costs add up quickly beyond 3 users and some features require paid add-ons
options.concern: May feel overwhelming with many notifications and channels for a small team
options.best_for: teams prioritizing powerful integrations and message history

options.name: Discord Nitro Classic
options.upside: Excellent voice chat quality with low latency, popular among gamers
options.tradeoff: Lacks some professional integrations and workflow tools
options.concern: Interface can feel less formal and more casual, which might reduce productivity
options.best_for: teams valuing voice communication and informal collaboration

options.name: Microsoft Teams Essentials
options.upside: Strong video conferencing and file sharing integrated with Office apps
options.tradeoff: Less flexible for gaming-specific integrations and can feel heavy for small teams
options.concern: Some users find the interface less intuitive compared to simpler chat apps
options.best_for: teams needing integrated video calls and file collaboration

options.name: Google Chat Business Starter
options.upside: Seamless integration with Google Workspace and easy collaboration on documents
options.tradeoff: Limited voice chat features compared to Discord or Slack
options.concern: Voice calls require switching to Google Meet, which can disrupt workflow
options.best_for: teams prioritizing document collaboration and Google ecosystem integration

shared_context: We are a small game studio with exactly 3 team members
Our monthly budget for tools is capped at $30
We want a messaging tool that supports both text and voice communication

personas.name: Priya
personas.background: team lead who has to justify the choice to management and hates surprises
personas.private_goal: I want a messaging tool with robust integrations and unlimited message history to support our game development workflow reliably.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference
ask about a practical constraint that could affect the choice
compare the preferred option with a realistic alternative
object to the main rival option with a concrete concern

personas.name: Goran
personas.background: Prefers straightforward, gamer-friendly communication tools with excellent voice chat quality.
personas.private_goal: I want a tool that offers high definition voice chat and low latency to keep our team connected during gameplay and collaboration.
personas.rejection_reason: was burned before by picking the cheapest option and paying for it later
